content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is an object storage service that allows digital creators to store and deliver their products without relying on third-party platforms like Gumroad or Payhip. This matters because it gives creators full control over their digital commerce stack, eliminating the need for intermediaries and their associated fees. By using Cloudflare R2, creators can retain more of their earnings and build a more sustainable online business.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack using Cloudflare R2 involves several key components. These include a frontend built with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and a payment gateway like NOWPayments. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is verified on-chain, and the digital product is delivered automatically via Cloudflare R2. This seamless process ensures a smooth user experience and minimizes the risk of payment disputes or delivery issues.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators who have been locked out of traditional payment platforms or are seeking to avoid their high fees. For example, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments charges only 0.5%. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921. This makes a significant difference for creators who rely on selling digital products to make a living. By using Cloudflare R2 and a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can take control of their earnings and build a more profitable online business.
Cloudflare R2 offers a cost-effective solution for digital product storage and delivery.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of a sovereign digital commerce stack include Cloudflare R2 for storage and delivery, a payment gateway like NOWPayments, and a backend powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These components work together to create a seamless and automated process for selling and delivering digital products. By using these components, creators can build a scalable and sustainable online business that is not dependent on third-party platforms or their associated fees.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can start by setting up a Cloudflare R2 account and uploading their digital products. Next, they can configure a payment gateway like NOWPayments and integrate it with their backend. Finally, they can test their setup to ensure that payments are being verified and products are being delivered automatically. By following these steps, creators can start selling their digital products online and retaining more of their earnings.

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can use a sovereign digital commerce stack that includes Cloudflare R2 for storage and delivery, a payment gateway like NOWPayments, and a backend powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This setup allows creators to accept payments in cryptocurrency and deliver their digital products automatically, without relying on traditional payment platforms.

After that, they can configure their frontend using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages and deploy their sovereign digital commerce stack. Finally, they can start selling their digital products online and retaining more of their earnings.
